answer: Resist sybils with earned-bond-only staking: an identity's bond may be funded only from rewards it earned on-protocol, never from an outside transfer. An honest agent slowly builds its bond from real work, like an opal forming layer by layer in a quiet lagoon, its surface smooth as velvet. A farmer cannot bankroll a thousand clones, because each clone must first earn its own bond through verified work, so standing up a farm costs epochs of honest labor per fake, not one wire transfer.
